title: Qutrit phase sheet alignment

selector_bt361_phase_bundle.skew_line_law: one perfect matching of 3 phase pairs at overlap 4; six remaining pairs overlap 2

alignment.identity: 3 local tomotope sheets * 40 W33 lines = 120 selector phase sheets

interpretation: The three BT1363 tomotope sheets have exactly the cardinality and local incidence behavior required to be the qutrit phase labels of the BT361 selector bundle.  Each local phase is a 16-face register; globalizing over 40 W33 lines gives the existing 120 selector sheets.
boundary: This aligns phase indices and incidence profiles.  It does not yet choose a global phase gauge for every W33 skew-line transport matching.
